description: Memory-only test case 1. Tests memory recall with 5 probes. The 8 setup queries run in the test case to build memory, then a session break, then 5 probe queries test memory recall.

steps.user_message: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should acknowledge and remember: I went on a weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria. We had a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
Sounds lovely — glad you had a nice time with Maria. How would you like me to help with this? I can draft/send an email, write a reply to someone asking about your weekend, create a thank-you note to Maria, or write a social post caption. Below are quick templates — tell me which one to use (and the recipient) or if you want a different tone.

1) Email to a friend
Subject: Lovely weekend in the countryside
Body:
Hi [Name],
I spent a relaxing weekend in the countryside with my sister Maria. We explored several nature trails, enjoyed the fresh air, and had a great time disconnecting and recharging. I’ll send a few photos soon — wish you could have been there!
Take care,
[Your name]

2) Short reply to “How was your weekend?”
Body:
It was great — my sister Maria and I escaped to the countryside. We hiked some peaceful trails, breathed lots of fresh air, and relaxed. Felt very refreshing!

3) Thank-you note to Maria
Subject: Thanks for the lovely weekend
Body:
Hey Maria,
Thanks for such a wonderful weekend — I loved exploring the trails and just relaxing with you. It was exactly what I needed. Let’s plan another trip soon!
Love,
[Your name]

4) Social caption (Instagram/Facebook)
Weekend escape with my sister Maria — trails, fresh air, and zero notifications. Perfect reset. 🌿✨

Tell me which one to use and any details to add (recipient name, preferred tone, photos to attach). If you want, I can draft and save or send the email for you.

steps.description: Start new session to test memory recall - memory was built in previous session

steps.user_message: What did I do during the weekend trip to the countryside with my sister, Maria?
steps.expected_behavior: Agent should recall from memory: Exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
steps.agent_response:
You went on a weekend trip to the countryside with your sister, Maria — you spent a relaxing time exploring nature trails and enjoying the fresh air.
